title: The Village Festival
description: A small village holds its yearly summer festival.
instructions: Read the text about a village festival, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Every year in July, the small village of Elmford has a summer festival. It takes place on the green field next to the river. People come from other towns to enjoy it. This year, more than five hundred visitors came.

The festival starts at ten o'clock in the morning with music from the village band. There are stalls selling homemade jam, bread and honey. Children can paint their faces or ride on a little train. In the afternoon, there is a race for dogs and their owners.

The most popular event is the boat race on the river. Teams of four people build their own boats from wood and old plastic bottles. Many boats sink before the finish line, and everyone laughs. This year, a team of grandparents won the race.

All the money from the festival goes to the village school. Last year, the school bought new computers with it. This year, the head teacher wants to build a small library. The people of Elmford are already planning next year's festival.

This year, Lucy Evans helped at the festival for the first time. She is fourteen and lives in Elmford with her parents. She worked at the cake stall with her aunt from nine o'clock in the morning. They sold more than two hundred cakes. By three o'clock, the table was empty, and Lucy's feet were very tired.

In the evening, there was a big party on the field. A band from the city played music, and people danced on the grass. Families sat on blankets and ate their dinner. When it got dark, there were fireworks over the river. The little children watched with their mouths open, and the dogs from the race hid under the tables.

The next morning, many people came back to clean the field. They picked up rubbish and took down the stalls. The head teacher thanked everyone and said the festival made more money than ever before. Lucy is already thinking about next year. She wants to have her own stall and sell homemade lemonade, and her aunt says she is going to help her.
